messages.subject: Project Granite — Disclosure Letter and bundle
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Please find circulated via the data room the draft Disclosure Letter together with the disclosure bundle (index at Appendix 1). The specific disclosures cover the Northborough change-of-control clause, the employment tribunal claim, the open HMRC VAT query and the leasehold break option. We've kept the general disclosure of the data room as previously agreed.

Grateful for any comments tomorrow so we can finalise ahead of Friday's completion.

Regards,

Amelia Hart
Associate
Castle & Vane LLP
